Describe the observable change and why it is needed.

Validation: commands run, results, and any skipped platform/backend checks.

Assurance: which model, theorem, emitted program, adapter, or running artifact
does this change affect? Update docs/assurance.md when a boundary changes.

For performance changes, include the workload, artifact hashes, allocation/memory
effect, and comparable before/after measurements. A microbenchmark is not server throughput.
